name: route_submit_emergency_report
description: Create a new unverified emergency report from a message describing an emergency, hazard, affected people, or a request for emergency help.

name: route_register_volunteer_offer
description: Record an explicitly stated offer by a person or organization to help with emergency response.

name: route_submit_field_update
description: Record an observation or update about local conditions, hazards, roads, evacuation progress, resource availability, or an area's status.

name: route_request_assistance
description: Handle a user's request for an informational assistance service: safe-route guidance, nearby shelter search, or local updates.

name: route_request_report_closure
description: Submit a request to resolve or cancel an existing emergency report.
